implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 475840502130.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 2100591000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over companyfacts statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.8071, '7': 0.555, '10': 0.3894}). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement; the 42-point spread here is unusually wide.
